eval: (()=>{ window.__e=0; window.addEventListener('error',()=>window.__e++); return '空状态: 部件='+CutterEngine.orderedParts().length+' 提示='+document.getElementById('cutNote').textContent; })()

(()=>{ document.getElementById('cutRun').click(); document.getElementById('cutExport').click(); document.getElementById('cutSortY').click(); return '空状态点按钮后 errors='+(window.__e||0)+' 提示='+document.getElementById('cutNote').textContent; })()

(()=>{ document.getElementById('cutStrategy').value='grid'; document.getElementById('cutStrategy').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return '切到网格策略: 参数控件='+document.querySelectorAll('#cutParams .rng').length+' 个(id='+[...document.querySelectorAll('#cutParams .rng')].map(r=>r.id).join(',')+')'; })()

(()=>{ document.getElementById('cutStrategy').value='bgcolor'; document.getElementById('cutStrategy').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return '切到背景色策略: 参数='+[...document.querySelectorAll('#cutParams .rng')].map(r=>r.id).join(','); })()
